acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Given income and expenses are entered, when I view the Dashboard, then I see an "Income vs Expenditure" card
Card displays Total Monthly Income in ZAR format (R X,XXX.XX)
Card displays Total Monthly Expenses in ZAR format (R X,XXX.XX)
Card displays Discretionary Amount (Income - Expenses) in ZAR format
Card displays Savings Rate as percentage: ((Income - Expenses) / Income) × 100
Visual bar shows income vs expense proportions (stacked horizontal bar)
Savings rate shows green if positive, red if negative
Card uses teal header (#0d9488) per UX spec

doc.title: Product Requirements Document
doc.snippet: FR40: System displays income vs. expenditure breakdown showing: total monthly income, total monthly expenses, discretionary spending amount, current savings rate

doc.title: Architecture
doc.snippet: Use big.js for all monetary calculations. Financial calculations without floating-point errors. Cent-level accuracy guaranteed.

doc.title: Architecture
doc.snippet: Use Zustand for UI state, Dexie for persistent data. Clean separation: Zustand = UI, Dexie = data.

doc.title: Architecture

doc.title: UX Design Specification
doc.snippet: Primary: teal-600 (#0d9488). Success/Health: green-500 (#10b981). Error/Debt: red-500 (#ef4444). Status indicators use semantic colors consistently.

constraints.constraint: All financial calculations MUST use big.js for precision. Store monetary values as strings.
No Zustand needed for this story - data flows from Dexie via useFinancialSnapshot.
Component location: src/components/dashboard/. Hook location: src/hooks/. Types location: src/types/.
Card header MUST use bg-teal-600 (#0d9488). Status colors: green-500 for positive, red-500 for negative.
Hook composition pattern: new hook calls existing hook (useIncomeExpense calls useFinancialSnapshot).
Loading state: use Skeleton component for loading states.
Bundle size at 631KB - monitor but not blocking.

tests.standards: Vitest with React Testing Library. Tests co-located in tests/ folder mirroring src/ structure. Use fake-indexeddb for Dexie mocking. Follow patterns from Story 3.1 tests. Hook tests should mock useFinancialSnapshot return values. Component tests should verify rendering, conditional coloring, and accessibility. All tests must pass before marking story complete. Current test count: 696 tests passing.
